chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqa, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding the man who copulates with an animal or rubs (masturbates).
So he (peace be upon him) said: 'Everything by which a man causes his water to descend in this and what resembles it, so it is adultery (Zina).'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on masturbation and copulation with animals in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: Imam Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) establishes that any act resulting in the emission of semen, including copulation with animals (Zina al-Bahim) and manual stimulation (Dalk), is classified as Zina. This ruling highlights the juristic principle that the defining characteristic of Zina in these contexts is the release of seed, extending the concept beyond traditional intercourse. The classification underscores the severity of these acts within Shia fiqh, linking physical emission directly to the legal category of fornication.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Ahmad Bin Al Hassan, from Amro Bin Saeed, from Musaddiq Bin Sadaqa, from Ammar Bin Musa, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the man who copulates with an animal, or rubs (masturbates)’.
So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Everything what man causes his water to descend regarding this and what resembles it, so it is adultery’.
en.sarwar: 3. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn al-Hassan from ‘Amr ibn Sa‘id Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from ‘Ammar ibn Musa who has said the following: “About the case of a man who engages in sexual intercourse with animals or causes his semen to discharge, abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Whenever a man causes his semen to discharge in this or that way it is fornication.’”
